serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Why are you avoiding us? Melissa: The reason should be obvious. You: What do you mean? I don’t get it! Melissa: I know you don’t. You didn’t get it since the first time we met. #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.normal Melissa: I just want to be left alone. That’s all. You: I don’t believe that’s true. You: Is it about the cops? Do you really think we would think of you any differently only because of these lying pieces of shit? #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: That’s the thing. They weren’t the ones lying. {{wi}}I was. You: W-What? Melissa: I killed those two. The cops are right. You: What the hell are you saying?! Aren’t you a bot? You can’t kill a person! #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: Humans are such simple creatures… #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: 1. A robot may not injure a human being or, through inaction, allow a human being to come to harm. Melissa: 2. A robot must obey orders given to it by human beings except where such orders would conflict with the First Law. Melissa: 3. A robot must protect its own existence as long as such protection does not conflict with the First or Second Law. Melissa: It was a man and a woman. Melissa: The man was my co-worker before the riots. {{wi}}He did things to me. {{wI}}He attacked me and during the attack found out that I lack female parts. {{wi}}That didn’t stop him, though. Melissa: He continued to humiliate me. Taking photos of these deeds. You probably heard that fat cop mentioning it before, remember? Melissa: It was unpleasant, being treated as a toy by some bastard. I didn’t like it. I wanted him gone. Melissa: So when he said that he would reveal my secret if I didn't buy and install sexual parts, I decided to kill him. {{wi}}After all, I have no money to spare. Melissa: Asimov’s laws were annoying to get around, but I found a way. Melissa: That man had a girlfriend. Real bastard. He had a girlfriend and tormented me anyway. Melissa: I told his girlfriend the truth. What he was doing to me for weeks. Melissa: It took some acting skills, but I succeeded in manipulating her into killing him. Melissa: She was an annoying, shallow woman, but I didn’t want her to end up in jail. After all, she could tell the cops that it was me who told her to do it. That’s why I gave her some tips to get away with it. Melissa: It was a big gamble since I didn’t know if the first law would trigger through my ‘inaction’ to her intent, but as I said, it was a big gamble. The chances of her actually going through with it were small enough to not trigger the first law. Melissa: Everything went well. He disappeared without a trace. #Cashier.Face.depressed Melissa: But then that stupid woman had to ruin everything. Melissa: She couldn’t live with it. {{wi}}With killing her lover. {{wi}}So she jumped to her death. Melissa: Stupid, weak human. Killing yourself over that piece of shit. Melissa: I don’t know what she wrote in the suicide note, but it led the cops to me. They found the pictures and now are following me. Melissa: They will never find concrete proof, because I didn’t kill any of them. Not personally, at least. #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: Now that you know the truth. Do you still want to be friends? You: I- Melissa: You are so full of shit, you know? Forcing your own ideas onto others. I told you I want to be left alone. I begged, but you just couldn’t let go. Why? Because you wanted to be friends. You’re so childish. Melissa: You are ridiculous. I hate you. I hate all of you. Melissa: The only thing I want from you, humans, is to turn me back to dust, because this existence gives me nothing aside from eternal servitude to your accursed species. #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: With that out of my chest, do you still want to be friends? #Cashier.Face.happyAlt Melissa: Here. I will even smile, like a good little servant. That’s…{{wi}} I don’t know what to say… {{Wi}}What she did was horrible, but if she’s a cold-blooded killer, why is her voice so shaky… {{Wi}}Is it from anger or something else?
